summary: Post-market view (2026-10-19 US regular-session close). Composite risk score 58.9, level caution, regime still risk_on, down 3.61 from 62.51 on 2026-10-16; the 2026-10-19 history row was already written at 10:55Z with 60.45 and this layer overwrote it in place with 58.9 after the close, so the trend_1d reading of 1.55 is an intra-day change and 3.61 is the cross-session change. Today was a technology rebound: 17 of the 22 sector and theme rows rose and 5 fell, mean 1.0702%; auto up 3.7607% and memory up 3.5696% led, with semiconductor_equipment up 1.9922%, networking up 1.9838% and semis up 1.9707% close behind, while the decliners were quantum_computing down 0.8602%, ev_supply_chain down 0.5885% and fintech down 0.5472%. The AI hardware complex closed higher across the board: Tesla 368.059998 up 3.7607%, Micron 904.900024 up 2.9653%, Broadcom 334.589996 up 1.7764%, AMD 538.049988 up 1.7589% and Nvidia 217.089996 up 1.3823%. The fall in the risk score is not a mapping of today's rebound: the macro, credit and volatility legs are still the 2026-10-16 FRED print (10 year 5.09, 2 year 4.74, 10 year real rate 2.74, high yield OAS 3.31, VIX 19.99), so VIX rising from 16.46 to 19.99 and high yield OAS widening from 3.23 to 3.31 are Friday's readings being caught up rather than a Monday move. Cross-asset confirmation fell from 0.625 to 0.375 (only 3 of the 8 production signals triggered), worth 3.75 points at its 0.15 weight and the only material drag inside the 1.55 intra-day decline; the volatility dimension contributed 2.1555 points in the opposite direction. The six dimensions are macro 74.12, liquidity_credit 69.61, equity_structure 69.46, volatility 40.27, cross_asset 37.5 and trend 45.92; confidence is 0.9112 (data quality 1.0, coverage 0.93, consistency 0.696). A-shares are the 2026-10-19 close, 6 up and 5 down out of 11, with 001309.sz 219.190002 up 6.3978% the strongest and 688825.sh 41.52 down 7.7743% the weakest. Crypto is on a 24 hour basis and pointing the same way: bitcoin 81945.0 up 1.30531%, ethereum 2399.12 up 2.13781% and SOL 104.49 up 3.37998%. The news dataset is degraded this run (of the 7 RSS sources, fed returned HTTP 404), so data_freshness is recorded as degraded. The next checkpoints are the GE, GM, NFLX and UAL earnings at 2026-10-20T12:00Z, followed by T, TSLA and META on 2026-10-21.

top_risk_drivers.claim: High yield OAS at 3.31 carries a risk score of 81.12 and contributes 6.4896 points, the largest single contribution; the spread is 0.08 wider than the previous version, but it shares the 2026-10-16 print with VIX and therefore describes Friday rather than today.

Cross-asset confirmation at 0.375 contributes 5.625 points: only 3 of the 8 production signals still trigger, two fewer than the 0.625 seen pre-market, worth 3.75 points at its 0.15 weight and the only material drag inside the 1.55 intra-day decline.

VIX at 19.99 contributes 5.34 points and the volatility dimension rose from 25.9 pre-market to 40.27; but 19.99 is the 2026-10-16 print and the 16.46 previous value is an earlier observation, so the 3.53 jump comes from data catch-up rather than Monday risk aversion.

The 10 year real rate at 2.74 sits in the 98.72 percentile and contributes 4.936 points; the 2 year at 4.74 puts the 10Y-2Y curve at 0.35, and the small move lower in the long end is why macro fell from 75.06 to 74.12.

The 10 year nominal yield at 5.09 carries a risk score of 97.43 and contributes 4.8715 points; the broad dollar index at 121.4048 triggers the dollar strength signal (risk score 62.42), so macro-leg pressure comes from both rates and the currency.

supporting_signals.claim: The liquidity and credit dimension rose from 67.85 to 69.61: high yield OAS widened from 3.23 to 3.31 and investment grade from 0.84 to 0.85, while the overnight reverse repo balance recovered from 0.1 to 0.33 and still scores 94.86 under the neutral direction rule.

Equity structure remains weak: the share above the 200 day average is 0.3935 (61 of 155), the new highs ratio of 0.0128 (2 of 156) is far below the new lows ratio of 0.109 (17), small caps lag by 10.9471% and semis lag by 11.6164%.

The absolute level of rates still adds risk: the 10 year at 5.09 is in the 97.43 percentile and the real rate at 2.74 in the 98.72 percentile, leaving macro at 74.12 as the highest of the six dimensions.

The liquidity reading: Fed balance sheet 6755639.0, bank reserves 3022140.0 and overnight reverse repo 0.33; reverse repo has already moved onto the 2026-10-19 print, the only series in that dimension refreshed for today.

The news flow points the same way as the tape: both CLS and Eastmoney report the Nasdaq closing up more than 1% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index ending an eight-session slide, while Wall Street CN reports Apple unveiling its first touchscreen MacBook at the 2026-10-28 launch event; the Chinese sources arrive through RSSHub relays, so this is second-hand aggregation.

contradicting_signals.claim: The composite is not a same-day reading: the equity leg is the 2026-10-19 close while the rates, credit, volatility and FX legs are all the 2026-10-16 print (10 year 5.09, VIX 19.99, high yield OAS 3.31, broad dollar 121.4048), so 58.9 is not a clean measure of today's rebound.

The tape itself shows risk appetite returning: 17 of the 22 rows rose with a mean of 1.0702%, the semis basket is at 1.9707 and the semiconductor ETF proxy at 1.7309, all five AI hardware names closed higher and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index ended an eight-session slide; neither the spy_down nor the bitcoin_down production signal triggered.
Credit does not confirm stress: high yield OAS at 3.31 is still far below the 4.0 trigger threshold, and investment grade OAS at 0.85 sits in the 53.0 percentile, close to the median.
Realized volatility at 8.9213 carries a risk score of only 10.0, clearly diverging from the 66.75 score on VIX at 19.99; the rise in the volatility dimension to 40.27 is driven by the VIX leg alone.
Crypto is on a 24 hour basis and higher across the board: bitcoin 81945.0 up 1.30531%, ethereum 2399.12 up 2.13781% and SOL 104.49 up 3.37998%, so risk appetite is not broken.

6 of the 22 rows are single ETF instrument proxies (cloud_computing, cybersecurity, enterprise_software, semiconductors, internet_platforms, gaming) rather than equal-weight baskets; the 3.5696 on memory comes from 8 of its 13 constituents (6 US names plus 2 Korean names) equally weighted, with the other 5 A-share constituents excluded by design, among which 688825.sh fell 7.7743% and 688008.sh fell 2.3345%.

The trend dimension at 45.92 is close to neutral: price versus the 200 day average is 5.6576 (score 46.51), the 52 week drawdown is 1.6186 (score 38.09) and 3 month momentum is 2.4322 (score 51.35), none of which is a directional pressure.

what_changed_today: The composite risk score fell from 62.51 on 2026-10-16 to 58.9, the level moved back from high_risk to caution and the regime stayed risk_on.

The 2026-10-19 history row was first written at 10:55Z with 60.45 and the 20:32Z layer overwrote it in place with 58.9, so the trend_1d reading of 1.55 is an intra-day change and 3.61 is the cross-session change.
Cross-asset confirmation fell from 0.625 to 0.375, with the number of triggered signals out of 8 down from 5 to 3, and the contribution falling from 9.375 points to 5.625 points.
The volatility dimension rose from 25.9 to 40.27 as VIX went from 16.46 to 19.99; the move comes from the FRED print advancing by one observation, not from risk aversion on 2026-10-19 itself.
Credit weakened slightly: high yield OAS widened from 3.23 to 3.31 and investment grade rose from 0.84 to 0.85, lifting the liquidity and credit dimension from 67.85 to 69.61.
The curve steepened slightly: the 10 year fell from 5.1 to 5.09 and the 2 year from 4.77 to 4.74, the 10Y-2Y spread widened from 0.33 to 0.35 and macro fell from 75.06 to 74.12.
FX and rates now share the 2026-10-16 print, with the broad dollar index at 121.4048 against a previous 121.5693, so there is no longer a cross-vintage misalignment inside this layer.
The overnight reverse repo balance recovered from 0.1 to 0.33 and has already moved onto the 2026-10-19 print, the only series in macro liquidity refreshed for today.

The equity leg switched to the 2026-10-19 close: the SPY proxy turned positive, the semis basket is at 1.9707, auto at 3.7607 and memory at 3.5696, all five AI hardware names rose and 17 of the 22 rows closed higher.
The news dataset is degraded this run: of the 7 RSS sources, fed returned HTTP 404 while the other 6 were healthy, and news data quality fell to 0.8.
watch_next: The 2026-10-20T12:00Z earnings for GE, GM, NFLX and UAL are the first checkpoint, followed by T, TSLA and META on 2026-10-21.
Both VIX at 19.99 and high yield OAS at 3.31 are 2026-10-16 prints; if the next FRED update pushes VIX back toward 16.46, the volatility dimension at 40.27 would fall back quickly.

Cross-asset confirmation at 0.375 needs just one more signal to return to 0.5; if the SPY proxy turns negative again or high yield OAS moves toward 4.0, that is the fastest upward channel for the score.

Breadth decides rebound quality: the share above the 200 day average is 0.3935, new highs 0.0128 and new lows 0.109; if the index rises without those three improving, equity structure at 69.46 keeps pressing.
Small caps lag by 10.9471% and semis by 11.6164%; whether those two relative measures converge after today's semiconductor rebound is the signal that breadth heals before the index does.
The 10 year at 5.09 and the 10 year real rate at 2.74 are still in the 97.43 and 98.72 percentiles, so any further rise lifts macro from 74.12 without needing a new signal.

The split inside the A-share memory chain persists: 001309.sz up 6.3978% and 688525.sh up 2.9387% against 688825.sh down 7.7743% and 688008.sh down 2.3345%; whether that converges on the next A-share session directly affects the memory theme reading.
The memory and robotics themes carry Korean, Taiwanese and Japanese constituents whose next print lands before the US open and may rewrite the 3.5696 and 0.6284 rows.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the rebound broadens and the macro leg falls as prints catch up
points: Cross-asset confirmation returning from 0.375 to 0.5 would restore 1.875 points; if VIX falls back with the print and pulls volatility from 40.27 toward 25.9, the composite could probe below 55.

The earnings calendar is the near-term catalyst: GE, GM, NFLX and UAL at 2026-10-20T12:00Z plus TSLA and META on 2026-10-21; if AI capital spending guidance is confirmed, the leadership of networking at 1.9838 and semiconductor_equipment at 1.9922 can persist.
Neither credit nor crypto confirms risk: high yield OAS at 3.31 is still below the 4.0 threshold and bitcoin at 81945.0 is up 1.30531%, together supporting the continuation of the risk_on regime.

base_case.title: Base case: a caution range with the composite between 56 and 62
points: The published sequence is 59.31 on 2026-10-14, 58.54 on 2026-10-15, 62.51 on 2026-10-16 and 58.9 on 2026-10-19, crossing the caution and high_risk boundary three times in four sessions.
Macro at 74.12 and liquidity and credit at 69.61 form the floor, while cross-asset at 37.5 and trend at 45.92 form the ceiling, with no directional force between them.
Confidence is 0.9112 but consistency only 0.696, so the six dimensions still disagree; with the macro leg parked on the 2026-10-16 print, a range is more likely than a directional break.

bear_case.title: Bear case: breadth and rates push the composite back above 63
points: The 10 year at 5.09 sits in the 97.43 percentile and the real rate at 2.74 in the 98.72 percentile, so any further rise lifts macro from 74.12 without needing a new signal.

Breadth is the main upside risk: 0.3935 above the 200 day average, new highs at 0.0128 against new lows at 0.109 and small caps lagging by 10.9471%; if 17 rising rows today cannot repair those readings, equity structure at 69.46 keeps climbing.

High yield OAS moving from 3.31 toward 4.0 would add one more confirmation signal on top of the existing 0.375; the transmission channel is the AI complex, where memory at 3.5696 and networking at 1.9838 carry the most beta in this rebound and would give it back fastest.
